_about: TiviBro's languages, the one list everything else is made from (scripts/i18n-langs.js writes it into the TV app, the web editor and the phone app).  code: the language; name: in its own language; english: in English; plural: the plural rule (scripts/i18n-langs.js PLURALS); from: a variant made from another language with its own words swapped (I18n.variant), no dictionary of its own to fill.  Add one with node scripts/i18n-add-lang.js.
